selection: Every Wycheproof flag combination is represented. Combinations with at most 10 tests are included whole; larger combinations contribute three evenly spaced tests. ArithmeticError contributes both valid and invalid cases, and all ValidSignature, PointDuplication, RangeCheck, IntegerOverflow, ModifiedInteger, BerEncodedSignature and SmallRandS tests are kept.
notes: tcIds and test objects are copied unchanged from the upstream file.
